$comment: Reasoned exceptions to G2 (frontend/src/__tests__/node-units-structure.test.ts): a product file outside a unit's folders that names the unit's type id as a string literal. Shape: { "<file>": { "<type>": "<why it must stay>" } }. It only shrinks; a new central mention of a unit is a missing seam.
